title: Trochlear Dysplasia
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Assess on axial images through the proximal trochlea, because the dysplasia is proximal and the distal groove can look normal.
Assess the cartilaginous surface rather than the bony outline, since the cartilage is what articulates.
Assess the sagittal images for a supratrochlear spur and for the crossing of the trochlear floor with the condylar outlines.
Record which level the measurement was made at, because the groove deepens distally.
Assess the whole patellofemoral joint alongside, since dysplasia rarely occurs alone.
